服务没有响应，请确认后端已启动。: The service is unavailable. Start Zhishu and try again.

图表显示前 50 组，完整结果见数据视图: Showing the first 50 groups. See Data for all returned results.
图表基于本次实际查询结果: Chart based on the executed query
模型连接成功，可以启用 AI 分析: Connection successful. AI analysis is ready to enable.
DeepSeek 只需填写 Key，其余由知数配置。: For DeepSeek, enter your API key. Zhishu handles the rest.

服务商提供的 HTTPS 地址: HTTPS base URL from your provider
兼容 Chat Completions；本地 Ollama 可填 http://: Chat Completions compatible. Local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1
已保存，留空继续使用: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
本地模型无密钥时可留空: Optional for local models without authentication
更换服务后请重新填写对应的 Key，旧 Key 不会发送到新地址。: Enter the key for this provider. Your previous key is not sent to the new endpoint.
只需填写一次，之后启动会自动记住。: Saved locally for your next session.
密钥加密保存在本机。AI 分析会将问题、表结构、最近对话和最多 30 行结果发送: Keys are encrypted locally. AI analysis sends questions, schemas, recent conversation and up to 30 result rows to your model provider. Provider usage charges apply.
同时清除已保存的密钥（不勾选则保留）: Also remove the saved API key
从文件开始，或连接你的业务数据库。: Start with a file or connect a database.
选择文件，或将 CSV 拖到这里: Choose a CSV file or drop it here
UTF-8 / GB18030 · 最大 20 MB · 10 万行: UTF-8 / GB18030 · Up to 20 MB · 100,000 rows
首行作为字段名称。导入后可预览结构、提问并生成图表。: The first row contains column names. Import to preview, ask questions and create charts.
请使用只读数据库账号。连接后读取指定 Schema 的前 30 张表结构，凭据加: Use a read-only database account. Zhishu loads schemas for up to 30 tables and encrypts credentials locally.
浏览器不支持流式响应。: Streaming responses are not supported by this browser.
连接中断，请从历史对话查看结果或重试。: Connection interrupted. Check conversation history or retry.
选择数据源，直接提问。结论、图表和查询过程都在这里。: Choose data. Ask a question. Explore the answer, chart and query together.
每一条结论，都可以查看背后的 SQL: Inspect the SQL behind every result
问问你的数据，例如：哪些地区的销售表现最好？: Ask your data, e.g. which regions have the highest sales?
Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
演示模式使用有限规则，不调用大模型。可在模型设置中启用 AI。: Demo uses predefined rules, not an AI model. Enable AI in Model settings.
AI 分析可能有误，请结合 SQL 和原始数据核对业务结论。: Check business conclusions against the SQL and source data.
SQL 校验后执行，结果来自当前数据源。: Validated SQL, executed on the selected data source.
管理分析的数据来源，查看真实字段与数据预览。: Manage data sources and inspect schemas and records.
最多显示前 20 行: Showing up to the first 20 rows
1. 选择演示数据，或添加 CSV / 数据库连接。: 1. Select sample data, import a CSV or connect a database.
2. 点击建议问题，查看实际查询生成的图表、数据和 SQL。: 2. Try a suggested question and inspect its chart, data and SQL.
3. 在模型设置中选择 AI 分析，保持 DeepSeek，只填 API Key: 3. Enable AI in Model settings. For DeepSeek, enter your API key and select Verify and enable.
4. 在同一对话中继续追问；历史对话会自动保存，也可以导出 Markdown 或: 4. Ask follow-up questions. Conversations are saved and can be exported as Markdown or CSV.
5. 下次双击知数即可自动打开网页，无需打开 CMD。启动中心可以最小化，用完点: 5. Launch Zhishu to open your workspace. Minimize the launch center while working; choose Quit Zhishu when finished.
